subject.title: refactor(config): retire legacy flat streaming keys to doctor-owned migration

question: Should the shipped `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-streaming` resolver API continue accepting flat streaming fields for third-party plugins?
rationale: The recorded approval covers persisted bundled configs and accelerated deprecation, but doctor cannot migrate arbitrary external plugin-owned inputs, so removing the released SDK fallback is a separate public compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve SDK compatibility
options.body: Keep exported resolvers flat-aware while bundled strict schemas and runtime callers consume only canonical nested config.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK change
options.body: Explicitly sponsor the public break with migration guidance, external-plugin compatibility coverage, and real upgrade proof.

options.title: Split the cleanup
options.body: Land doctor correctness and bundled schema changes separately while deferring the SDK contract change.

recommendation.title: Preserve SDK compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep exported resolvers flat-aware while bundled strict schemas and runtime callers consume only canonical nested config.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and the PR body connect this person to the current refactor and compatibility decision, while Vincent Koc introduced the original contract.
